children: Gilt investors' focus is on U.K. Treasury Chief John Healey's speech due at 0830 GMT as government borrowing costs climb. Healey is expected to reassure markets about the government's spending plans ahead of the budget on October 28, Mizuho's Evelyne Gomez-Liechti says in a note. "Better growth rhetoric may help at the margin, but markets will care more about whether the numbers preserve fiscal credibility." Ten-year gilt yields rise 1.2 basis points to last trade at 5.151%, Tradeweb data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
